service.en: Issue or renew an employment contract
service.ur: ملازمت کے معاہدے کا اجراء / تجدید

about: Issue a new employment contract and work permit, or renew one, for an employee.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Establishment has a valid licence with no violations
Renewals are submitted by the authorised signatory
Apply for a new contract within 60 days of the employee entering the country or changing status
Permits can be renewed up to 60 days before expiry
Skill levels 5-9 need a guidance workshop
documents: Ministry-approved contract signed by employer and employee
Supporting documents attached after checking the retrieved data
fees: Federal fees apply; amount not shown on the page
Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
